steps.text: Plug the device to monitor (the load) into the outlet on the Appliance Status Sensor.
Plug the Appliance Status Sensor into an unswitched outlet.
steps.expect: Beep; status LED solid green or red; after 20 seconds a double beep and calibration mode

steps.text: Make sure the load is off or in standby.
Tap the SET button to record the low energy state.
Turn the load on or to its high energy state.
Tap the SET button to record the high energy state.
steps.expect: Double beep; status LED solid green in the high state, red in the low state

notes: Calibration mode lasts 4 minutes; after that, taps are ignored. To calibrate again, unplug the Appliance Status Sensor and reinstall it.
Monitors loads from 7 W to 1800 W (15 A at 120 V).
Don't plug it into a switched outlet, a filtered power strip or an AC filter.
If using home automation software, add it to the software after the double beep, once it is in calibration mode.
The trigger point is set 25% above the low state if the low state is recorded first, or 25% below the high state if the high state is recorded first.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the Appliance Status Sensor beeps, about 3 seconds.

notes: Set the responder to the state for the load's high energy state first; after these steps press and hold the responder's SET button for 3 seconds. The Appliance Status Sensor double-beeps and its status LED shows the load state.
This links scene 1 (load reaches its high energy state). Without scene 2, linked responders turn off when the load reaches its low state.

To link scene 2 (low energy state): press and hold the SET button until it beeps (LED blinks green), again until it beeps (LED blinks red), and a third time until it beeps (LED blinks green), then press and hold the responder's SET button for 3 seconds.
Calibrate the load's energy states before linking.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the Appliance Status Sensor beeps, about 3 seconds.
Press and hold the SET button again until it beeps, about 3 seconds.

notes: Then press and hold the responder's SET button for 3 seconds within 4 minutes; the Appliance Status Sensor double-beeps.
To unlink from scene 2, press and hold the SET button four times, each until it beeps (LED blinks green, red, green, then red), before pressing the responder's SET button.
Unlink responders you no longer use; otherwise it keeps retrying commands and slows the system.

steps.text: Unlink any devices the Appliance Status Sensor controls.
While holding down the SET button, plug it back in.
steps.expect: Beep; status LED solid green or red

steps.text: Keep holding the SET button for 3 seconds.

steps.expect: After a few seconds, a double beep and the status LED changes color

notes: Clears all Insteon links. The calibrated high and low energy states are kept; recalibrate to change them.
